gaps.title: A canvas that animates unprompted is not followed
gaps.noPage: reader-initiated animation is pinned by test/canvas_test.go; the unprompted case is the canvasStreamEvery knob, a configuration choice rather than a parity property

gaps.title: Icon fonts ship whole, never subsetted
gaps.noPage: a byte-cost gap, not a rendering one: whether the glyphs draw at all is fonts/icon-ligature's business

gaps.title: A font registered through the FontFace API cannot ship; its glyphs render as their ligature names
gaps.noPage: page lands with the fonts corpus group later in this change

gaps.title: wheel and hover are protocol surface no client sends
gaps.noPage: needs a pointer-move vocabulary the interaction executor does not have yet; P-115's page will carry both when it grows one

gaps.title: Password and sensitive-autocomplete values never cross the wire
The landside browser is a phone with a mouse: touch is never emulated, so maxTouchPoints is 0 and pointer-aware pages lay out differently per half
gaps.noPage: both harness browsers are mice too, so the divergence cannot arise in-corpus; imported real pages carry the widened page-height band it causes

gaps.title: File upload is not implemented
gaps.noPage: clicking a file input landside opens a native chooser nothing intercepts — the gap includes that hazard — so no safe corpus interaction exists until Page.setInterceptFileChooserDialog is wired

gaps.title: Clipboard copy executes plane-side only; cross-tab paste fidelity is absent
gaps.noPage: clipboard access needs permissions headless CDP does not grant uniformly; the plane-side path is covered by the client's unit tests

gaps.title: Find-in-page has no chrome-UI affordance
gaps.noPage: a chrome-UI gap, not a mirror-rendering one

gaps.title: A frame is only preemptible between messages; a large snapshot owns the link while it sends
gaps.noPage: a latency property of the scheduler, measured by the netem suite's timings rather than by parity

gaps.title: The document is delivered whole, never viewport-first
gaps.noPage: a delivery-order property; parity measures the settled document, which is identical either way

gaps.title: A closed shadow root is invisible: such a component mirrors as its light DOM only
gaps.noPage: page lands with the shadow corpus group later in this change

gaps.title: Reader-preference media features are answered plane-side, so the two halves may genuinely lay out differently
prefers-color-scheme is settled landside; changing it re-snapshots every tab
srcset and sizes are dropped; one server-chosen rendition ships
An animated GIF ships its first frame only
Canvas, WebGL and video are photographs: region shots, taken after input, never live
Ad and creative networks are blocked landside, so their content never exists to mirror
Alerts, confirms and prompts are auto-accepted landside and never shown to the reader
gaps.notes: deliberate today, but confirm() answering yes to everything deserves a reader-visible affordance eventually

gaps.title: Landside scroll is matched by range fraction, so IntersectionObserver-driven lazy loading fires approximately
gaps.noPage: needs a scroll-then-measure page with a tolerant contract; planned for the corpus's next round

gaps.title: A mirrored sub-document is laid out plane-side against a box, not a viewport: reader fonts, no percentage heights, fixed and sticky resolve against the wrong thing
gaps.noPage: page lands with the frames corpus group later in this change

gaps.title: A cross-origin frame that cannot be mirrored stays a labelled box; past the depth or count limits, so does one that could be
A cross-origin frame smaller than 64x32 gets no label at all — indistinguishable from a bug
gaps.noPage: page lands with the frames corpus group later in this change

gaps.title: A select change never reaches the landside page except through a form submit
gaps.notes: setValue handles INPUT, TEXTAREA and contenteditable and answers false for everything else; the echo shows the reader their choice and the page never hears it

gaps.title: setvalue and blur are dispatched to the top-level agent only; a non-append edit inside a mirrored cross-origin frame is silently lost
A blob: image source serialises as a landside blob URL the client can never fetch: a broken image with no fallback and no Missing notice
gaps.noPage: page lands with the images corpus group later in this change

gaps.title: Favicons never travel: TabState.FaviconID is decoded by the client and set by nothing
gaps.noPage: a favicon is chrome UI, invisible to the mirror probes; recorded so the dead wire surface is not mistaken for a feature

gaps.title: HTML comments are never mirrored, though KindComment exists on both halves of the protocol
gaps.notes: renders nothing, so nothing is lost; kept as the record that the protocol claims surface neither end implements

gaps.title: object, embed and applet are dropped whole with no stand-in: an unexplained hole where an iframe gets a labelled box
gaps.noPage: page lands with the textmisc corpus group later in this change

gaps.title: Dead wire surface: TypeIntegrity, OpImage and ScrollEvent.Visible are never produced or consumed
gaps.noPage: wire bookkeeping with no rendering consequence; recorded so the next protocol change deletes it rather than trips over it

gaps.title: Downloads are unhandled: a download link writes a file onto the VPS and the reader sees nothing happen
gaps.noPage: clicking a download link landside leaves a file on the test host and no observable mirror change to assert on; needs Browser.setDownloadBehavior wiring first

gaps.title: window.open and a plain click on target=_blank open a landside tab no client tab will ever show
gaps.noPage: page lands with the nav corpus group later in this change

gaps.title: There is no print path: window.print does nothing for the reader
gaps.noPage: printing is chrome UI the harness cannot see; that @media print sheets do not leak into the screen is pinned by css/layers-scope

gaps.title: mousemove-driven widgets — drag-and-drop, sliders, hover menus — have no input path
gaps.noPage: needs a pointer-move step in the interaction executor; catalogued for the executor's next revision alongside P-004

gaps.title: An audio element is photographed as a still control strip; no audio ever crosses
gaps.noPage: page lands with the media corpus group later in this change

gaps.title: DPR is never applied to image transcodes or region shots: every picture is soft on a 2x or 3x screen
gaps.noPage: page lands with the images corpus group later in this change

gaps.title: A prefers-color-scheme media query nested inside a plain style rule crosses with its question intact instead of being resolved landside
gaps.noPage: page lands with the css corpus group later in this change

gaps.title: The shell's font-src 'self' may refuse every blob: webfont the pipeline ships
gaps.notes: suspected from reading the CSP against the blob resolution; fonts/csp-blob is the verification, and its first measured run settles this entry's status
gaps.noPage: page lands with the fonts corpus group later in this change

gaps.title: An external SVG sprite reference resolves to a URL the sandboxed frame can never fetch: the icon renders as nothing
gaps.noPage: page lands with the images corpus group later in this change

gaps.title: A style write onto a canvas permanently blanks its photograph until the reader touches something
gaps.noPage: page lands with the media corpus group later in this change

gaps.title: The GIF tap-to-play the transcoder's comment promises does not exist in the client
gaps.noPage: the still-frame half is P-016's page; this records the docs-versus-code drift so one of them gets fixed

gaps.title: The mirror's own :root color and font leak into pages that rely on UA defaults
gaps.notes: found by the parity probes' first run: color #111 and the frame's sans-serif inherit into the mirrored page wherever the page never says otherwise, where landside shows black and the UA serif
gaps.noPage: page lands with the css corpus group later in this change

gaps.title: A top margin that collapses through the page's body is lost at the mirror boundary
gaps.notes: found by the parity probes' first run: the fixture's h1 margin collapses through body and pushes content 21px down landside; plane-side the gap vanishes and the document is 22px shorter
gaps.noPage: page lands with the css corpus group later in this change

gaps.title: The server's echo of the reader's own focus arrives a round trip late and yanks focus back into the field they have already left
gaps.notes: found by the interaction executor's first run: reader focuses A, the landside replay confirms it, the reader clicks B, and the confirmation for A — applied through the host's onFocus in the gap after ownership of A ends — steals focus back. On the 1.2s link this bites any reader who moves between fields within a round trip.
gaps.noPage: timing-dependent by nature: the executor settles before each step so every other page measures its own gap, and a page for this needs a deliberate fast-click knob in the executor first
